Item.Description: The tuna or tuna products described herein are not certified to be dolphin safe and contain no marks or labels that indicate otherwise.

The tuna or tuna products described herein are certified to be dolphin safe - Tuna not harvested with a purse seine net, and not harvested in any fishery that has been identified by the Assistant Administrator as causing a regular and significant mortality or serious injury to dolphins

The tuna or tuna products described herein are certified to be dolphin safe - Tuna harvested using a purse seine net outside the Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean (ETP), in any fishery for which the Assistant Administrator has not determined that there is a regular and signification association occurring between dolphins and tuna

The tuna or tuna products described herein are certified to be dolphin safe - Tuna harvested by a purse seine vessel outside the ETP in a fishery in which the Assistant Administrator has determined there is a regular and significant association occurring between dolphins and tuna
The tuna or tuna products described herein are certified to be dolphin safe - Tuna harvested in the ETP by a purse seine vessel having a carrying capacity of 400 short tons (362.8 mt) or less
The tuna or tuna products described herein are certified to be dolphin safe - Tuna harvested in the ETP by a purse seine vessel of more than 400 short tons (362.8 mt) carrying capacity
